english.note: A speaker uses this fuller term when explicitly treating the sofa as a type of seat or distinguishing it from other furniture.

examples.english: This sofa is much more comfortable than an ordinary chair.
examples.traditional: 呢張梳化椅比普通椅舒服好多。
